interactions.title: The two halflings wanted to witness the story
lines: DM: Everybody's with you. They're all immune to fear, except for the 2 new halflings, who are not having a good time of it, and maybe you should feel slightly guilty for dragging them through a—
Delwath: They—weren't they the ones who are like, 'We want to be here to record the story'?

before: Delwath: Or they'll Dimension Door, but they can't all Dimension Door. Seeker's the only one of them with Dimension Door.
Seeker: You know what? They don't have a skyship.
Delwath: They do not have a skyship.
Seeker: Is Faldrick still with us on the skyship, or do we leave all the civilians?
Delwath: No, no.
after: Delwath: We force them to come, though? They begged us to let us let them come. So, I mean—
Wellby: Are we allowing them to leave? No. But did we force them to come?
Delwath: They want to leave, they're welcome to leave. They just—what are we gonna do? They're, like, over Drankor. There's nowhere for them to go. We're not gonna, like, do it—
Seeker: All.
Delwath: Mission to fly them away. But there.

review.reason: The pair is discussed collectively; their individual Willow/Mica matches remain provisional in the entity map.

interactions.title: Bizarro Delwath: return token, hidden dangers and the undefended base
lines: DM: You all appear. Simulacrum—or Bizarro Delwath looks up as you teleport, his longsword humming slightly in his hand as he scans and turns to who's visible.
DM: 'Great, kill me! Do you really think this is the only defense that we've left? The only trap? The only way the city protects itself?'
DM: 'Kill me, and you'll never know where all the hidden dangers are.'
Delwath: Now, Delwath would— lying bastard. He's just making shit up.
DM: You can see around his neck there's this—there's a chain, and there's a black piece of marble hanging on this chain with a Drankorian rune etched into it.
DM: The rune is— I made up a word for this. It's—it's the Drankorian word for 'return.' Fairly magical. ((Token-removal mechanics))
DM: Simulacrum Delwath reaches out, and Bizarro Delwath looks at simulacrum Delwath in horror as the 2 Delwaths— it's—
DM: Simulacrum Delwath now having this amulet in his hand.
DM: As Delwath swings at Bizarro Delwath, with simulacrum Delwath holding the amulet.
DM: As your sword hits, simulacrum Delwath—or Bizarro Delwath—body begins to disintegrate from the legs up, turning into this fine powdery white dust. And there's just this lingering—
DM: Smile on his face as, like all of his body except his head, is vanishing, and he just says
DM: 'Nice of you to leave your base undefended and open for teleportation.'

before: Delwath: Yeah, I'm rolling. I rolled real Delwath with real dice, and I rolled, and I had an advantage. Rolled a 19 in a 2. Okay.
DM: This is probably the best set of initiative rolls in history.
Delwath: Yes.
DM: Wellby, 28, Kenzo, 22, Delwath, Seeker, and simulacrum Delwath at 21, and Riswynn at 20. Yep.
Delwath: So I mean, the goal here is to kill him before he can even move. So let's go.
after: Wellby: Faldrick.
Seeker: You check.
Wellby: And Faldrick.
DM: 'Yeah, what's up? It's kind of creepy over here.'
Wellby: Yeah.

interactions.title: Faldrick answers the telepathic check
lines: DM: 'Yeah, what's up? It's kind of creepy over here.'

before: DM: 'Nice of you to leave your base undefended and open for teleportation.'

DM: Nope.
Seeker: Wait. They can't steal the skyship. Oh, no.
DM: He vanishes.
after: Delwath: M.

Delwath: Okay, time's ticking. So I wanted to ask this earlier, but I didn't want to distract from this combat. I scryed the group of 3. So I scryed, Delwath, and I scryed the group. Yeah, where are the group of 3? Where were the group of 3 compared to—to compare to where we are right now?
DM: So.
Seeker: Oh, what's this?
DM: The 50 feet. I think.

interactions.title: Bizarro Wellby threatens Fausto’s intervention
lines: DM: ((The opening exchange of blows)) he sees you appear, and he turns and—and he looks at you, and he smiles, ((The first blow lands))
Delwath: Tree is going to do something bad.
DM: 'If I were you, I wouldn't leave enemies in my back. Don't you actually want to go kill Fausto? You know that powerful wizards can teleport too, don't you?'
DM: 'Give in to your temptations.' ((Turn ends))
Seeker: Wait. What did he say?
Delwath: He's trying to—I don't know. He wants us to, like, worry that Fausto is going to do something bad to the ship or the seekers.
Seeker: Bizarro Seeker is going to teleport to the ship.
Delwath: Hold on. I'm going to tell Faldrick.
Delwath: 'Please constantly mumble and talk and be clear, like— give us a running background—'
Seeker: I'm here. I'm here. I'm here.
Delwath: 'Of everything that is going on on the ship. Be prepared for an attack, and constantly tell us what's going on.'

before: Delwath: Does this mean we—this means we should take the amulet, right? Somebody's better do it. This—
DM: Yes, does not require a check to take an amulet.
Kenzo: Could I just have taken the amulet instead of doing my second attack?
DM: It takes an action to take the amulet.
Kenzo: Oh, okay.
after: DM: Bizarro Kenzo is gonna run from behind the wall towards simulacrum Delwath. 1st attack is a 20— 5.

Delwath: Should he cast shields? The simulacrum Delwath also cast armor of Agathys intentionally to screw Kenzo, who gets 5 attacks, but doesn't do that much damage per attack. He's not casting shield. It's fine.
DM: Okay, make a Con save.
Kenzo: Oh, man!
Delwath: 7. What did he send us.

interactions.title: The docks doubles: stolen tokens, failed diversions and defeat
lines: DM: Bizarro Kenzo is gonna run from behind the wall towards simulacrum Delwath. ((Combat))
DM: Bizarro Kenzo is, like, ((Condition)) mumbling, but he—he looks as— Kenzo—as this stone golem grabs the amulet, he, like, looks up groggily and starts laughing.
DM: 'You know, Rai probably took the dagger when he fled. Shouldn't you go chase after him?'
Delwath: They're like messing with us.
Delwath: No, none of it's true.
Riswynn: That even doesn't make sense in this timeline.
DM: Riswynn grabs the amulet. ((Condition description))
DM: ((Dispel Magic)) simulacrum Delwath, who vanishes.
DM: Bizarro Kenzo falls over crumbling to stone, as Delwath pummels him to the ground. ((Turn ends))
DM: 'You know, I scoured the city looking for adamantine. It's the 1st thing we did. There is none.' ((Spell selection))
DM: Yeah, he's standing—Seeker's standing there staring at the stone grain and looking at it like— you can—you can sort of hear him muttering under his breath, Bizarro Seeker:
DM: 'Now, if Fausto teleports they can surprise Faldrick. Time is almost ready. Delay them. It's 1 of the—'
DM: 'I fought them once before. They killed me, but they won't kill Fausto and 8 of his most powerful allies.'
DM: Oh, that's actually super classic. So Riswynn fires a Guiding Bolt towards Kenzo, and he's like, 'Nope,' and just knocks this bolt of energy right at Wellby, who dies. Oh, amazing!

DM: You reach—you reach for the distracted form of yourself and just managed to grab this amulet as you're—as the Seeker—Bizarro Seeker is just not paying attention to what you're doing, and you now find yourself with the amulet in your hand. ((Positioning))
DM: ((Final blow)) Bizarro Seeker just melts into a pile of sand and dust at Riswynn's feet.
DM: Dark ladder collapses. I think the ladder vanishes. ((Turn ends))
Seeker: I just want to say, as I—my eyes pop open again— the last thing I said before I went down was, 'It's okay, guys, you don't have to heal me. I'll be fine.'
DM: ((Turn timing)) she's gonna look around at all of you, and she's gonna say,

DM: 'You think this is— you think you're doing well, but trust me, you know what magic I'm capable of. There are no adamantine daggers left to find in Drankor. And the more time you spend here fighting us— dot dot.'
Wellby: 'I think it's only gonna take 6 seconds,' Wellby shouts down.
DM: Wellby lands and grabs the amulet from her.
DM: ((Wellby's final arrow)) Riswynn, who then disintegrates in a cloud of dust.

review.reason: The source contains several hostile diversion claims and corrected identities; cuts preserve the selected dialogue and final outcomes while removing the attack sequence.

interactions.title: The surviving return amulets
lines: DM: They all disintegrate. You have the amulets.
Kenzo: That's cool. Oh. That might be useful for teleportation.
DM: We also have the various taunts that they left you in.
Kenzo: The taunts will live on forever. Yep.

before: Seeker: Yeah, yeah.
Kenzo: Let's just head back to the—now that Fausto has taken it over.
Seeker: I know, right? So we Rainbow Bridge back to the skyship.
Kenzo: Wait, wait, there's no—there's no treasure for us to loot. That's sad.
Delwath: Yeah, I was just disintegrated.
after: Seeker: And the lightning tower, which will just take like 1 min to like test out and fire someone.
Delwath: I think it's, like, 'Let's teleport back to the ship,' but somehow we ended up at the top of the lightning tower. I don't know how that happened.
Seeker: Teleport, missiles.

interactions.title: The party keeps the phylactery plan
lines: Delwath: Thought we were going after the phylactery still trying—
Riswynn: We're just gonna disbelieve all of the 'There's no adamantine daggers here' taunts and pursue our plan.
Delwath: We're gonna—we're gonna start by heading towards Rai's last known location.
DM: Which you're almost directly above, right now in the skyship.

before: Seeker: No, I mean also Seeker.
Delwath: You mean Seeker's going to sleep? I thought you meant you were going to sleep.
DM: Yes, but before you all go to—that was— that was great. That was a little longer than I intended because it's a lot of work, which is totally fine.
DM: You return to the ship now. It still is like, you know, mid-morning, and you're looking out across the city wondering like, what's your next move here?
DM: And definitely, I do not anticipate you spending an hour discussing it, but maybe 10 min before we sign off would be okay, just so that I have some sense of—
after: Seeker: And we use this stone sense scanning.
Delwath: There is an open question as to whether we long rest, like—but you can't long rest multiple times in a day, right?
DM: You have to wait till tonight to long rest, but you could hang out on the ship.
Delwath: So do we just float on the ship all day and, like, chill?
Seeker: Well, we'll be using—we'll be scanning for adamantine.
